coveredChanges: Failed-turn Retry (agent-history slice 1): durable bounded failure record, Retry card per upstream canRetry, atomic history+queue replacement, harness thread reset, saved selection and draft preservation.

Runtime consumers for stored preferences: notification sounds with upstream trigger/suppression rules and synthesized ADE packs, keep-awake power request while agents work, per-data-dir single-instance coordination forwarding startup URLs.

Shortcut ledger slices S1-S4 and S7: terminal focus/toggle, context selector, file tree changes/files modes, Ctrl+C stop routed to the active chat surface, image center, thinking-effort cycling for harness-discovered efforts.
Read-only code views number lines uniformly like upstream code blocks.
limits: The701-row scope and17331-function reference index remain preserved. Full semantic, line-by-line, pixel and identical reasoning parity is not established.
All live and packaged GUI claims remain historical until this exact new binary is separately exercised.

Retry: fresh display id (upstream reuses the message id); dispatch uses the saved chat selection, not unsent composer choices; failure records bounded to 2000 chars/4096 bytes; Ctrl+Enter ERROR_RETRY priority, edit/replace and revert/restore checkpoint are not implemented.

Sounds: built-in packs are synthesized PCM, not upstream audio assets; the question chime is an ADE addition; real audio output was not exercised in gates (opt-in smoke). Keep-awake uses Win32 power requests; real request smoke passed once.
Single instance uses an ADE-specific local-socket protocol; non-ownership lock errors start uncoordinated.

Shortcuts: thinking-effort cycling only for harness-discovered efforts; shortcuts are not reachable from WebView2 page content; Markdown/SVG preview shortcuts (S5/S6), tab pin and edit-nearest-message remain missing.
Background unread/error/waiting status, native search gitignore parity and browser screenshot fallback (B6) remain outside this cohort.
Cursor actual login/inference and remote services without credentials remain unverified.
publication: Not published separately; superseded by checkpoint 12 before publication.
